I am 74 years old. I never went to school, not one day. But I have farmed these 2 mu of cotton in Quzhou for 20 years, so I know this land and I know cotton. I do not listen to people from the city or read papers. I watch my neighbors. Old Wang has 3 mu next to mine, and his cotton always looks dark green and full of bolls. I do what he does.

Last year, I put one 50-jin bag of compound fertilizer on my whole 2 mu before planting, and one 50-jin bag of urea when the plants flowered. That is 25 jin of compound and 25 jin of urea for each mu. The cotton gave me about 500 jin per mu. This year I will do exactly the same thing, because changing is dangerous. If I use less, the plants turn yellow and I lose money. If I use more, I waste cash I do not have. My family has three people, and we live on this land. I would rather waste a little fertilizer than risk a bad harvest.

I hire the village tractor man to rotary till my field. It costs 30 yuan per mu. I plant in late April with improved seeds from the county supply store, not the old kind. I need about 2 jin of seed per mu. I put the compound fertilizer down when I plant. When the cotton flowers in July, I spread the urea. The urea is white pellets. The compound bag has three numbers on it, but I do not know what they mean. The shop says it is good for cotton, and Old Wang buys it, so I buy it too.

I irrigate three times from my well. First after planting if the spring is dry. Second in June when the buds come. Third in August when the bolls are growing fat. The water is free but the diesel for the pump costs about 20 yuan each time. I spray pesticide four times. The cotton bollworm is my enemy. I buy bottles from the shop, the kind with the red label, and walk the field with my sprayer. Four times is enough if you keep your eyes open.

I expect about 550 jin per mu this year if the weather holds and the worms do not come too bad. That is about 280 kg. I do not dare hope for more than that.
